name: rust-ext-review-toolkit
description: Analysis agents for Python extensions written in Rust with PyO3: unsafe-block soundness auditing, PyResult propagation, GIL discipline (attach/detach, foreign callbacks, free-threading), panic safety across the FFI boundary, #[pyclass] Send/Sync/frozen trait bounds, #[pymethods] protocol correctness, #[pymodule] init, Bound/Py/Borrowed lifetime handles, PyO3 version compatibility, complexity measurement, and git history analysis. Tree-sitter-rust-powered, with optional clippy/miri/cargo-expand integration.
